biggest_catch: The cash-out bar is high relative to earnings: third-party trackers report 25,000 points = a $15 gift card in the US, while typical surveys pay 50-500 points and invitations arrive only a few times a week — most members take months to reach a first redemption, and survey invitations are never guaranteed.
catches: Survey invitations are not guaranteed and depend on your demographic profile; availability varies by country.

YouGov's official support article sets the redemption floor at 5,000 points; in the US the lowest practical tier reported by third parties is 25,000 points for a $15 gift card (official US tiers are shown only after login).
Typical surveys award 50-500 points and take 5-15 minutes, so the effective hourly rate is very low.
Points do not expire, but you must reach the full redemption threshold before claiming anything.
Rewards vary by country (gift cards in the US; PayPal/bank transfer in some other regions).
Screen-outs are less common than on other panels but can still happen.

steps: Create a free YouGov account and verify your email address (a short welcome survey credits starter points).
Complete your profile surveys so YouGov can match you with relevant studies.
Complete surveys when invited by email or in the app — points are credited per completed survey.
Once your balance reaches the reward threshold, log in, click the 'Home' tab, scroll to 'Rewards', and choose a gift card or cash reward.
Fill in your personal details, click redeem, then follow the claim instructions in the email from rewards@reward.tremendous.com.
timing: Redeemable once the points threshold is reached; voucher claim instructions are emailed after redemption. US third-party reports put the lowest gift-card tier at 25,000 points ($15), which typically takes months of casual participation.
